tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid yig rnam 'byed shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid yig rnam 'byed shing rta zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// shes dang shes bya'i dngos po'i dra ba rnams// ma lus rang gzugs gsal por rang shar ba'i// shel dkar me long gsal ba'i mthu mnga' ba// dang po'i sangs rgyas de la gus pas 'dud// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid ye shes mchog /mchog gi dang po rdo rje'i rnal 'byor lam// lam bzang yan lag drug gi zab gsal chos// chos ston chos rgyal rigs ldan tshogs la 'dud// shes dang shes bya'i chos rnams rnam dag dag pa'i rol pa las// las dang las kyi duḥkha kha ba'i rdul phran rab tu 'dren// 'dren pa 'dren pa'i lha mchog mchog rnams rnam kun sbyor ba drug /drug kyang drug tu ston mkhas mkhas tshogs tshogs mchog shes der 'dud// skal bzang skye rgu'i 'dab brgya ji snyed pa// thub bstan nges gsang don 'dom klung lam du// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sna tshogs shing rta yis// nyer 'dzin dra ba'i 'dzum stong cher spel yang*// deng sang skal ngan sa 'dzin rdzun bag gi// log bshes tarka gyi na'i sngo bsangs ma// zlos gar mgrin brgya 'khrol 'di mi bzod par// rgyud rgyal ti ma'i grong gi 'ching dbang las// zla bzang sprin 'dzin gar gyi 'jo sgeg gis// legs thon legs bshad smig rgyu'i lding khang du// zab don mig gsum pa yi gtsug gi nor// nongs nyes dga' ba brgya pas ma 'gongs shing*// rmongs 'khrul rlung gi shing rtas ma bsgribs par// brlang min ngag 'jam dri bzhon gyis drangs te// legs bshad rnam bkra'i lang tsho ngom bzhin du// phyogs su 'gro byed phreng ba'i zil dngar gyi// skal bzang 'dab stong dgod pa'i 'phrog byed 'di// rnam g.yeng pra tsā ya sprin gyi so can la// myur bar 'gong ste skyo med gnas phye yi// mos ldan dga' bas longs shig spro dga' brtas// zhes mchod par brjod pa dang*/

bshad par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor chen po/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid kyi rim pa 'di nyid 'chad pa la gsum ste/ rgyud sde gang las byung ba dang*/ de dag gang las brgyud pa dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ so sor spong dang bsam gtan dang*| |srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod// ces dang*/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ sgrub pa yi ni dam tshig dang*| |de bzhin nye bar bsnyen pa dang*// sgrub pa don gyi dam tshig dang*// sgrub pa chen po dag dang ni// zhes dang*/ kyai rdo rje brtag pa dang po'i le'u brgyad pa las/ dang po nag po rab tu bsgom// gnyis pa dmar po'i rnam par bsgom// gsum pa la na ser por bsgom// bzhi pa ljang gu de bzhin no// lnga pa kha dog sngon po dang*// drug pa dkar po'i lus can no// yan lag drug bsgoms rnal 'byor pas// dga' bral mtha' yang de bzhin no// zhes dang 'khor lo sdom pa dang*// sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang*/ bde ba yis ni 'grub par 'gyur| |zhes sngags bzlas pa ni srog rtsol yin la/ de'i rjes su 'dzin pa shugs bstan dang*/ de bzhin du bsam gtan dngos su dang*/ sor sdud shugs bstan/ bde ba zhes ting 'dzin yongs su bstan nas rjes su dran shugs bstan du bshad pa'o// de ltar rgyud sde thams cad du gsal bar bshad nas kyang dus kyi 'khor lo shin tu dmigs bsal nas gsungs te/ rgya 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs pa blangs te dus 'khor chen pos/ gang gis mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes pa des/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes so// gang gis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes pa de 'khor ba pa ste/

zhes gsungs la/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa ni sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rtsa ba yin te/ nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// zhes pa nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces pa'i bar gyi yan lag drug bsgom pa'i thabs dang de'i ngo sprod gsungs la/ yang man lung bas/ gtsug tor chen po rmad byung gtsug /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che// zhes pa'i bar gyi yan lag drug bsgom tshul bshad pa yin zhes gsungs so// des na bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs tshad ldan gyi rgyud mtha' dag nas gsungs shing*/ khyad par du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas spros pa cher gsungs pa dag go// gnyis pa de dag gang las brgyud pa ni/ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas/ zla ba bzang po/ lha dbang gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ rnam rgyal gshin rje bzang po/ phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang*/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs| zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas sa skyong*/ dpal skyong dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa chung ba/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po/ 'brog lo tsā ba shes rab grags pa/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung*/ sgro ston snam la brtsegs/ yu mo grub mi bskyod rdo rje/ thugs sras dharme shwa ra/ mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug jo 'bum chen po/ se mo nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma ba/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun chos kyi rje/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug pad+ma dkar po/ bstan pa'i srog shing dharma rā dza/ mkhas pa'i dbang po nya dbon chen po/ grub dbang kun dga' blo gros/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ lo chen rat+na bha dra/ gling smad rin chen 'byor ldan/ kun mkhyen dam pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen/

grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' lhun grub/ ā kā sha ni rā bho ga /de nyid kyis bdag la bstsal ba ste brgyud pa'i rim pa dag go// de ltar na bod yul skyo med kyi khyon chen po 'dir yan lag drug gi khrid rgyu skar gyi phreng ba ltar dpag gis mi lang ba'i nang nas ches mchog tu 'phags pa/ kun mkhyen chen po nas brgyud pa gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po nas rim par brgyud de brgyud pa gzhan gyis ma bslad pa de dag ni skar tshogs kyi dbus su nam mkha'i nor bu lhag pa lta bu ches cher 'phags pa kho na dag go// brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa 'di ston pa'i slob dpon ni/ yang dag pa dang*/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i slob dpon dang*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dag go// slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni/ bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ dang por yang dag bstan bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje'i theg la lhag par gnas// de nyid sgom zhing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs// slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog cing de nyid las ni tshangs spyod ldan// bdud rnams la ni rdo rje'i dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpar rab grags pa'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ yang de nyid las/ sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gi thugs dang zhal las gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o// zhes bla ma mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing khyad par du dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shing*/ de nyid gzhan la ston nus pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ mtshan dang mi ldan pa'i bla ma ni/ yang de nyid las/ nga rgyal dang ldan khros nas zil mnan dam tshig kun bral rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med// slob ma rnams ni bslu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi dge ba'i gnas las sems nyams dbang ma bskur// longs spyod dag la rab chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa// de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya// zhes de lta bu'i bla ma ni rdzogs byang gi rgyu dmyal ba dang 'dra bas spang bar bshad do// chos nyams su len pa'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/

yang de nyid las/ zab cing rgya che la sems bla ma'i nges pa la dga' stong pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan yon tan shes// thar pa don gnyer rgyud la gus shing g.yo ba min pa'i sems ldan de nyid thob pa shin tu sbed// gdug pa rnams kyi grogs nyams slob ma de nyid bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyis shin tu bsdu bar bya// shes rab dbang la sogs pa'i rgyud de gzhan zhes bya bar slar yang 'bring po bsod nams dag gi rgyur// zhes gsungs pas/ slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de/ dus kyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ras bris su dbang ma tshang ba med pa thob par bya dgos pa'i shes byed dag go// gsum pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon du 'gro ba la'ang gsum/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ khyad par dang gsum/ dang po la bzhi las| ji skad du/ dal 'byor rten sogs rnyed dka' bsam// nges shes gsum dang ldan byas la// zhes gsungs pas/ tshe 'di la mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bsam pa/ snyom las dang le lo'i gnyen por 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ srid pa la bde bar 'dzin pa'i gnyen por 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ dal 'byor gyi lus don yod du bya ba'i phyir las rgyu 'bras bsam pa rnams te/ de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi po spyi 'gro ltar zhe thag pa nas rang rgyud la 'dre nges bsam par bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la'ang bzhi ste/ ji skad du/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya bzlas// maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing bla ma bsgom// zhes pa bzhi las/ dang po rgyud snod rung du sgrub pa skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi khrid ni/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rang nyid gang du 'khod pa'i gnas 'di nyid tha mal du 'dzin pa spangs te/ 'og min nam/ dga' ldan nam/ bde ba can la sogs pa dag pa'i zhing gi yon tan mtha' yas pa bkod pa du mas rnam par bkra ba'i dbus su rin po che'i gzhal med khang shin tu mdzes pa'i nang du/

rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri rgya che ba'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid bcom ldan 'das rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po la nyi ma'i 'od kyis reg pa ltar sngo bsangs 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig pa/ shin tu 'dzum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs can rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rtse phran la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas mdzes par brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos yongs su brgyan pa/ de'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dkon mchog nyid rnam pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bdag nyid du mas bskor ba/ de dag gi g.yas su seṅge'i khri la byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog ni thabs kyi sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dang*/ shes rab kyi sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang*/ mthu stobs kyi sems dpa' gsang ba'i bdag po/ bskal bzang gi sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pas gtso mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad longs sku'i cha lugs mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ g.yon du nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'phags pa dgra bcom pa shā ri'i bu dang*/ maud+gal gyi bu la sogs pa mchog brgyad dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang mtshan dpe rab tu ldan yang ltar snang cung zad mi gsal ba/ rgyab tu rin po che'i khri la dam chos dkon mchog ni sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang de dag thams cad kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i ngo bor yongs su rdzogs pa nyid chos dkon mchog yin mod kyang rnam pa mtshon byed du pustaka gyi rnam par bzhugs pa/ gtso bo dang rang gi mtshams kyi mdun du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga dang lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i steng du/

phrin las sna tshogs pa'i bdag nyid kyi pad+ma ljang gu 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa/ zhal dang mgrin pa nag po/ phyag gnyis dang lte ba sngon po/ zhabs g.yas dmar mo brkyangs pa/ g.yon dkar po bskums pas drag po'i dga' ma u ma dang bcas pa mnan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum sna tshogs gser mdog /zhal gcig /phyag gnyis kyis gri thod 'dzin cing zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu skra thor tshugs bcings pa'i rtse mor rin po che dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ rdo rje nor bu'i rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ lag gdub| ske rags/ rkang gdub/ dar dpyangs/ phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs ldan pa/ de'i mtha' skor du yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de dag gi khri'i thad du dam pa ye shes chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams bar chad srung zhing dngos grub stsol ba'i ched du bzhugs par gsal btab la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos tshogs dge 'dun chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa snying thag pa nas brgya dang rtsa brgyad bya'o// de nas sems bskyed pa'i dang po smon pa sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs/ sho lo ka tshar gsum tsam don dran par bya/ 'jug pa sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa thob 'dod kyis lam 'dir 'jug pa dag go// de nas mthar skyabs yul dang gzhal yas khang sogs mi bsdu bar gsal btab pa'i ngang nas/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad de'i ngang nas byed pa ni srung 'khor mchog yin zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs so// gnyis pa sdig sgrib dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i khrid ni/

skyabs yul gsal ba'i ngang nas/ rang tha mal pa'i spyi bor steng gi nam mkha' khru gang gi thad tsam du seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs pa'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po sgreng thabs su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ dang rdo rje la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rigs thams cad kyi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che'i rtse phran sogs rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du rdo rje sems ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin cing phyag zhabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab kyi dpral bar sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid āḥdamar po/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid hūm̐ nag po rnams gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs nas dbang bskur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes kyis dbyer med du byas la/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas btab ste mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bltas la/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig |gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/

rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i cha stod la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha| dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ ma me muñtsa badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes stong phrag gcig nges par bzla dgos/ de'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po bab/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung ma lus pa dud khu dang sol khu 'am/ rnag khrag gi rnam par 'og sgo gnyis dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas thon te dag /bdud rtsi'i rgyun des rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar thams cad gang bar mos/ mthar rdo rje sems dpas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams dag go// zhes gnang ba byin nas rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid la thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur/ ces mos par bya'o// gsum pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni gnyis te/ dang po sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ rin po che la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi chus sbags pa'i steng du 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu lnga bkod la/ sngar gyi skyabs yul kho na ltar gsal btab bo// gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ rab rin po che/ 'bring zangs dang 'khar ba/ tha ma sa dang shing las byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi chag chag btab la/ 'bru dkar po rde'u dang phub ma sogs kyi skyon med par dri bzang gi chus sbags pa'i tshom bu bkod bzhin pa'i ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/

gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba lang spyod/ shar du sgra gcan/ lhor nyi ma/ byang du zla ba/ nub tu dus me/ gzhan yang lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa gtsang zhing rnam par dag pa nyid bla ma yi dam dus kyi 'khor lo dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs longs spyod rnams// rin chen maṇ+ḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa// blo yis dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul| |thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes dbul/ slar yang mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu bsdus nas gong ltar dbul te/ de 'dra ba'i maṇ+ḍal tshar nyer lngas phul lo// de nas mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gong ltar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces ngag nas brjod cing phyag stong phrag gcig 'tshal/ de nas tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim par bya'o// bzhi pa rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' mda' gang tsam gyi thad du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba'i dbus su| ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa bcom ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu'am baiḍūr+ya'i phung po ltar dwangs shing 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/

zhi ba'i mdangs bzang po'i ngang tshul can/ dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa'i tshul can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*| snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ do shal/ ska rags dang*/ 'og pag dang*/ se mo do ste rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas mdzes shing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥrnams kyis mtshan pa la zab lam 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa skad cig gis spyan drangs te rdo rje 'chang la bstims pas bla ma dang mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par dmigs shing*/ de'ang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi thugs rje dang nus mthu mkhyen brtse ye shes ma lus pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid can du bsams la/ de lta bu'i don dran bzhin pas| yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar bas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang*// khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang*// khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do| |khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes zhe thag pa nas don dran pas bstod la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen shākya'i tog /ces sogs kyi gsol 'debs tshar lnga bya/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas rdo rje 'chang la thim zhing*/

de nas slar yang dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan bla ma mtshan rnams kun rang bzhin// bdag gi spyi bor lus kyi thig le la// nye bar zhugs nas bum dbang dga' ba'i chus// sad pa'i bag chags dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ sad pa'i bag chags kyi dri ma dag /bum dbang thob/ sku rdo rje'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /slar yang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa sems can kun gyi skad// bdag gi mgrin par ngag gi thig le la/ nye bar zhugs nas gsang dbang dga' ba'i mes// rmi lam bud shing bsreg par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ rmi lam der 'khrul gyi dri ma dag /gsang dbang thob/ gsung rdo rje'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /slar yang*/ rje btsun bla ma mi rtog chos kyi sku// bdag gi snying khar yid kyi thig le la// nye bar zhugs nas shes rab ye shes kyis// gnyid 'thug mun pa sangs par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying khar thim/ gnyid 'thug gti mug gi dri ma dag /sher dbang thob/ thugs rdo rje'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag |slar yang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku// bdag gi lte ba ye shes thig le la// nye bar zhugs nas shes rab chen po'i dbang*// bskur bas 'pho med dga' ba thob par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi lte ba nas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/ 'pho ba'i bag chags kyi dri ma dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /de ltar gnas skabs bzhi'i dri ma yongs su sbyangs shing dbang bzhi legs par bskur nas rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pas de dag gi bdag nyid can du byas/

slar yang*/ kun tu bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can gyi// gdod ma'i lus ngag yid dang ye shes rnams// khyod kyi rdo rje bzhi dang mnyam sbyor bas// mchog bde mngon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas de ltar bgyi zhes gsungs te/ rdo rje 'chang 'od phung lngar phung gis zhu nas/ rang gi snying khar thim pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs dang bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsams la dmigs med du bzhag cing*/ rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar bsags sbyang sngon 'gro bzhi po 'di/ rab zla gsum dang 'bring gnyis/ tha na'ang zla gcig la nyin thun gnyis dang mtshan thun gnyis te thun bzhir/ skyabs yul la skyabs 'gro brgya rtsa brgyad re/ rdor sems la yig brgya stong phrag re/ tshogs zhing la maṇ+ḍal nyer lnga re/ phyag stong phrag re/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gsol 'debs tshar lnga re rnams thun re la ma chag pa nges par bya dgos te/ de lta bu'i sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyang la 'bad mi nus pa'i slob ma la rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di bshad na chos srung gi tshogs kyi chad pa yong nges so// de rnams ni thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi'o// bzhi pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la gnyis te/ lus tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog pa'i phyir bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi nyer bsdogs dben pa gsum bstan pa'o// dang po la'ang kha cig gis gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom pa dang*| kha cig dpa' rkyang du bsgom pa sogs yod mod kyang snga ma ni ha cang spros pa ches drag pa dang*/ phyi ma ni lha'i snang brnyan bskyed rim zhal phyag sogs yongs rdzogs la brtan pa mi thob pa sogs kyi skyon yod pas de gnyis ka dor te/ 'dir gtso bo yab yum zhal phyag yongs rdzogs mngon byang lnga bskyed kyis bsgom pa 'di kho na 'thad par sems pas/

de'ang dang por/ oṃ shū n+ya tā'i sngags don dran pas chos thams cad dngos po dang rgyu 'bras ngo bo rnams dmigs su med pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma ljang gu 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du aṃ las nyi ma dang āḥlas zla ba nya gang ba/ a las sgra gcan/ slar yang a las dus me ste gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ a -i ṛ u li/ a o ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la aṃ rnams g.yon skor dang*/ lā wā rā yā hā/ ār au ar ai ā li ū ri ī āng aḥrnams g.yas skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod pa'i mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo dbyangs so gnyis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mngal 'dzin pa khu ba'i khams me long lta bu'i ye shes gzugs phung skyed byed rnam snang dang*/ de'i 'og tu nyi ma'i dal gyi steng du/ l+la w+wa rar y+ya/ haha s+sa k+ṣak+ṣa ṣ+ṣa sh+sha rar/ t+ta thatha d+da dhadha n+na/ p+pa phapha b+ba m+ma/ ṭ+ṭa ṭhaṭha ḍaḍa ḍhaḍha ṇ+ṇa/ ts+tsa tsh+tsha dz+dza dzh+dzha nya/ k+ka kh+kha g+ga gh+gha ng+nga ste brtsegs pa rnams g.yas skor dang*/ nga gha ga kha ka| nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭaha/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha tha ta/ rar sha ṣa k+ṣa sa/ ha ya ra wa la ste rkyang pa rnams g.yon pa rim pa gcig gis 'khod pa'i dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo gsal byed brgyad cu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mngal 'dzin pa rdul gyi khams mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ tshor ba'i phung po skyed byed rin 'byung zla ba'i dbus su rang rig hūm̐ yig dri za'i rnam shes ri bong gi mtshan ma lta bu sgra gcan gyi khams so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'du shes kyi phung po skyed byed snang mtha' dang*/ zla nyi hūm̐ dang bcas pa rnams dang gcig pa nyid du srog gi rlung rnams ye shes kyi bzhon pa he yig nag po bya grub ye shes/ dus me'i khams 'du byed kyi phung po skyed byed don grub dang*/ zla nyi dbyangs gsal rlung sems kyi sa bon gnyis dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dres pa las dbyangs rnams kyi nga ro gsal byed rnams kyi rnam par bcad pa rnam shes gzhol du med pa'i ha yig srog med pa dang rlung sems kyi rnam pa'i srog gi dbyangs a yig rnams tshogs pa las/

haṃ yig bde ba chen po chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes te rnam par shes pa'i phung po skyed byed mi bskyod pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de lta bu'i haṃ yig de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid zla ba dang khu ba'i rang bzhin gyi rnam pa thams cad gzugs kyi ngo bo khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje shugs rgyu'am/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa/ 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ sku mdog sngon po/ zhal bzhi/ rtsa zhal nag po drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ rdo rje nor bu dang*/ rdo rje rna rgyan dang*/ rdo rje mgul rgyan dang*/ rdo rje ska rags dang*/ rdo rje rkang gdub dang*/ rdo rje dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ dbus nag /g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang*/ g.yas g.yon phrag pa mdun nas brtsams te/ dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste phrag drug /de las gyes pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi dpung pa mdun nas brtsams te/ dang po gnyis sngon po/ gnyis pa gnyis dmar po/ gsum pa gnyis dkar po ste dpung pa bcu gnyis/ de dag las gyes pa'i phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ g.yas g.yon gyi dang po bzhi bzhi nag po/ gnyis pa bzhi bzhi dmar po/ gsum pa bzhi bzhi dkar po/ phyag thams cad kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang gu/ sor mo rnams rtsa ba nas brtsams pa'i tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste de rnams la nor bu'i sor gdub 'od 'phro bas mdzes par brgyan pa/

g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje/ gnyis par ral gri/ gsum par rtse gsum/ bzhi par gri gug /dmar po bzhi'i dang por me'i mda'/ gnyis par rdo rje lcags kyu/ gsum par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ bzhi par tho ba/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por 'khor lo/ gnyis par mdung*/ gsum par dbyug pa/ bzhi par dgra sta/ g.yon gyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por dril bu/ gnyis par phub/ gsum par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnam par rgyas pa/ bzhi par khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhi'i dang por gzhu/ gnyis par rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum par rin po che/ bzhi par pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por dung*/ gnyis par me long*/ gsum par rdo rje lcags sgrog /bzhi par tshangs pa'i mgo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ phyag so so'i phyag mtshan rnams kyis phyag gi mthil gyi pad+ma mdzes par byed pa'i mtshan mar byas pa/ 'og nas rim gyis zla nyi sgra gcan dus me'i steng du shin tu rol pa'i zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyangs pa'i 'og tu 'dod lha dmar po gdong bzhi pa/ lag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis me tog gi mda' lnga dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis gzhu dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa mnan cing*/ g.yon dkar po cung zad bskums pa'i 'og tu drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ lag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa mnan te bsgyings pa/ bdud kyi lha mo dga' ma dang*/ drag mo'i lha mo u mas zhabs kyi mthe bong nas 'dzin cing gdong dman par byed bzhin pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi pang du phreṃ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i nyi ma dang dngul gyi rang bzhin can mdun nas 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog zhal bzhi/ mdun nas g.yas skor du ser dkar sngo dmar gyi zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas kyi bzhir gri gug /lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi bzhir tho ba/

thod pa/ zhags pa pad dkar 'dab brgyad pa/ rin po che bsnams pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyangs shing zhabs g.yas yab la 'khyud pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par 'jug par gnas pa'o// yab kyi gtsug tor nas lte ba'i bar du rtsa a wa dhū ti sngon po/ yar sner hoḥyig dkar zhing 'tsher ba dang mar sner hoḥyig dmar po 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ dpral bar sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid āḥdamar po/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid hūm̐ mthing ga rnams gsal ba las/ lte ba'i hoḥyig las gtum mo'i me 'bar bas chags pa chen po'i ye shes kyi 'od zer bcom ldan 'das yab yum lhan cig tu ri bong 'dzin pa lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas thig le'i gzugs kyis bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gdan gyi steng du gnas par gyur par mos/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bo las byung ba'i lha mo bzhis bcom ldan 'das la spyan mas/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum// rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas// bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis| |dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// mā ma kīs/ mā ma kī bdag sring mo ste// rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas// bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// gos dkar mos/ gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste// rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bur te// bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// dam tshig sgrol mas/ sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste// rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas// bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis// dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod// lha mo bzhis mgrin gcig tu/ stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni// 'gro ba gdon pa'i bsam pa yis// 'gro ba'i mgon po spro bar mdzod// ces zhus pa'i glus nye bar bskul bas/

stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das nyid glu rnams kyis rab tu sad par gyur pa na/ 'gro ba'i khams gsum po thams cad mig 'phrul dang sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas sems can gyi don gyi slad du slar yang zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le de nyid dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i hūm̐ yig sngon po de yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa de nyid las byung ba'i bdag nyid 'bras dus kyi bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i bar bskyed rim de tsam mi nus na dus 'khor yab yum lhan skyes bsgoms kyang rung tsam yin no// de nas lha rgyas bsdus gang sgom yang*| rgyu dus kyi 'khor lo ltar la yab yum gnyis kar rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan can zhes pa de 'bras dus 'dir brjod mi dgos so// de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo gzhug pa ni/ rang gi snying khar hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs rang nyid dang 'dra ba'i zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras| phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bdag dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang rdo rje shugs yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa bde ba'i ngo bor zhu bas bdag dang ro mnyam par gyur/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni rgyas pa ltar dang mdor bsdus pa gnyis las/ rgyas pa ltar na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum zhes pa nas/ rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyi bdag 'jug dang*/ bsdus par na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas dbang gi lha'i rnam par spyan drangs/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bcu gcig bskur/ dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag ste/ rang gi spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par dmigs so// de nas dbang rgyas bsdus gang byas kyang rgyas gdab pa ni/ rang gi gtsug tor du thig le la a las mi bskyod pa/ snying khar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor du i las don grub/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du u las snang mtha'/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la e las rnam snang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ri las rin 'byung*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la aṃ las rdo rje sems dpa'/ zhes sku'i rgyas gdab/ slar yang lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la l̥/ snying khar chu'i dal la u/ mgrin par me'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ/ dpral bar rlung gi dkyil 'khor la i/ gtsug tor tu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la a/ zhes gsung gi rgyas gdab/ slar yang dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥ zhes thugs kyi rgyas gdab| rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor aḥ zhes ye shes kyi rgyas gdab/ slar yang*/ dpral bar a las zla ba'i dal la oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug /g.yas gsum 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon gsum ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ mgrin par raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad la yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po/ dmar dkar nag po'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug

/g.yas gsum pad+ma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum nor bu/ ral gri/ dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ snying khar thig le la sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po'i dbus su/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje nag po/ nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug |g.yas gsum rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon gsum dril bu/ ral gri/ nor bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ yum gyi lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor hā rgyu rnams kyis mtshan par gyur par mos so// de nas slar yang yab yum gyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar haṃ/ spyi bor hā/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa bug pa phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las āḥlas pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rtsa bar hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lte bar nga rgyal gyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ lte ba'i hoḥyig dri ma med pa'i glog ltar gtum mo'i me thur sel gyi rlung gis bskul bas dhū ti'i lam nas gyen du 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis g.yon gyi rtsa la bab pa phung po lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor lnga dang*/ g.yas kyi rtsa la bab pa spyan ma la sogs pa khams lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor lnga bsregs shing rgyu ba med pa dang*/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po yul la 'jug pa med par byas/ me'i 'od de'i zer gyis spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pa tsam gyis ri bong can zhu ba ltar thig le'i gzugs kyi spyi bo nas mgrin par dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar slebs pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar slebs pa na khyad dga'/ lte ba nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor slebs pa phaṭa yig gis bkag pas phyir ma 'phos par lhan skyes kyi dga' ba nyams su myong bar mos la bsgom/

slar yang thig le de nyid gsang gnas nas lte bar rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu'i tshul du gshegs pa dga' ba/ lte ba nas snying khar rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i tshul du gshegs pa mchog dga'/ snying kha nas mgrin par skyes bu'i byed pa'i tshul du gshegs pa khyad dga'/ mgrin pa nas dpral bar bral ba'i 'bras bu'i tshul du gshegs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar bsams la yun ring du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa oṃ badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra satwa haṃ/ dur+ṭan ta da ma ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'dod lha'i nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ /de ltar lha'i rnal 'byor yun ring du bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las rang 'dra ba'i lha dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar yang rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu thugs ka'i sa bon la bsdu ba sogs sngags 'khor spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pa can du gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ham̐k+ṣ+malawaraya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ hrāṃḥhrīḥhriṃ hruṃ hri liṃ hra swā hā/ zhes nye snying dang*/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sku'i bzlas pa dang*/ huṃ zhes thung ngu gsung dang*/ hūm̐ zhes ring po thugs kyi bzlas pa ste de thams cad yab kyi'o// oṃ bi shwa mā tṛ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa yum gyi sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa yum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa'o// de ltar yab yum gyi bzlas pa ci 'grub la 'bad cing bzla bar bya'o// mthar pad gdan nas rim gyis bsdus te yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab sku stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/

hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ nā da'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag par bya'o// skabs 'dir lus gnad grol ba zhig dgos pas| lus gnad ni rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung lag gnyis bsgreng ba'i rdo rje khu tshur brla'i rtsa bar bkan la bcar te rab tu bsgrengs/ dpung pa phyir dgye zhing rgal tshig bsrangs/ lta stangs rdo rje'i gtsug tor gyi lta ba ni/ sna rtse nas gzhal ba'i sor bcu drug gi thad nas slar yang sor bzhi gyen du 'phags pa'i thad kar bsgrad pas blta zhing*/ lus gnad byed bcing de'i ngang nas zhag bdun la sogs lus gnad ma grol bar du 'bad dgos shing*/ lus gnad grol ba'i mtshan nyid ni bshad ma thag pa'i lus gnad de nyid la mi zug pa dang*/ na ba sogs ci yang med par bde 'bol le zhig yong bas de lta bu ma byung gi bar na zug ji ltar byung yang lus gnad 'di kho na la bslab cing lus gnad 'di bas gzhan pa'i sems skyil mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya sogs sla chos byar mi rung zhing lus gnad ma grol bar dben gsum sogs gdams pa'i gnad bstan par mi bya la/ yang lus gnad ma grol bar na zug che ba yun ring na/ lci ba yar ga me la bsregs pa'i thal ba 'jam po dang thang phrom gyi 'bru phye mar byas pa mar nag bskol ba la sbyar te gang na sar byugs na grol bar 'gyur ro// de ltar zhag grangs mang nyung ci tsam nas lus gnad grol yang grol zin nas/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi nyer bsdogs dben pa gsum la slob pa ni/ mun pa'i khang bu shin tu gnag cing gsal dkar cung zad tsam yang med pa'i nang du stan bde bar 'dug ste lus kyi dge ba phyag dang skor ba sogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs kyi rnam g.yeng mtha' dag spangs la dben par byas te stan gyi rgyab cung zad mtho ba la lus gnad snga ma ltar bya ba lus dben/ ngag gi bzlas brjod chos spyod sogs dang long gtam ngag 'chal mtha' dag spangs la smra ba gcod pa ngag dben/

rnam rtog lung ma bstan phra rags sbom gsum spang ba zhes pa/ rnam rtog thol skyes bkag pas kheg pa min mod/ rtog pa gang skyes de'i 'phro mi mthud cing rjes mi 'brang bar gang skyes kyi dus dran 'dzin gyis slebs par byas la/ gang yang yid la mi byed par thol skyes rbad gcod ces bya ba/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po'i phyag len dang mthun par bzhag cing*/ gal te de las 'phro na lta stangs rang la sems 'dzin byed pa man ngag go// de dag ni sems dben te 'di rdzogs rim gyi nyer bsdogs thun mong ma yin pa yin pas dben gsum kho na la nges par bslab/ zhag bdun bslab pa phyag len yin no// de ltar sngon 'gro rnams legs par grub nas/ skabs 'dir dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchog dbang gong ma bzhi phyag rgya gsum la brten nas bskur bas lam dbang du smin par byas la/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la don drug gam/ bzhi'am/ gsum du 'dod pa las/ spyi don drug ltar na/ bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur zhing rnam pa bcu ste mtshan ma'i dbang gi du ba smig rgyu me khyer 'bar ba/ zla ba/ nyi ma sgra gcan cha shas thig le rnam mthong ba'i dbye bas ma brtags pa ye shes kyi phung po dag go// rnam par shes pa bsam gtan rnam par shes pa'i phung po ste yul yul can bcu po gcig nyid du sna tshogs pa bsam gtan no// mi bskyod pa nyid do// srog rtsol dag kyang ral gri 'du byed kyi phung po ste g.yas g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gcig tu 'dre'o// can no// slar yang rnam pa bcu ste 'dzin pa tshor ba'i phung po ste srog gi 'dzin pa lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor gyi pad+mar 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i dbye bas so// phyag na rin po che gdol pa mo rjes su dran pa 'du shes kyi phung po ste gdol pa mo dbu ma'i rtsa la rjes su dran pas 'dod pa'i gnas skabs bcu'i dbye bas so// pad+ma 'dzin par 'gyur te/

dpal ldan ting 'dzin rnam par snang mdzad de ting 'dzin rnam pa bcu ni/ rlung bcu po rnams 'gog pa'i phyir ro// 'khor lo can re re'ang dbye ba lnga rnams kyis te/ slar yang gang la'ang a sogs ka sogs rnams kyis phye ba'o// zhes de bzhin gshegs pa drug gi dbye bas spyi don drug go// gnyis pa spyi don bzhir byed na/ sor sdud dang bsam gtan bsnyen pa'i yan lag /srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag |rjes dran sgrub pa'i yan lag /ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go// gsum pa spyi don gsum du byed na/ sor bsam thog mar dge ba sku rdo rje/ srog 'dzin bar du dge ba gsung rdo rje/ rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin tha mar dge ba thugs rdo rje rnams so// de rnams las dang po sor sdud nyams su len pa la'ang*/ snyan brgyud las/ kun la drug drug shes byas te| |zhes pas/ sor sdud kyi sgra don/ bsgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag /rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed/ thob pa'i 'bras bu dang drug go// dang po sgra don ni/ 'grel pa dri med 'od las/ 'dir dbang po lnga po yul lnga la 'jug pa med par dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu 'jug par byed do// zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ yul dang yul can bcu po rnams| |rang gi 'jug gnas thams cad la// 'dod pa so sor sdud pa'i phyir// so sor sdud pa zhes bya'o// zhes dang*/ bu ston gyis/ thugs kyi rdo rje nam mkhar bzhag /yul dang yul can 'brel ba bcad// stong gzugs mngon du gyur pa yis// so sor sdud pa sgom par shog /ces dang*/ kun mkhyen jo nang pas/ yid rnam rtog 'byung ba so sor bcad// ces sogs gsungs shing*/ de yang pra t+yā ha ra zhes pa'i pra ti so sor dang*/ ā ha ra za ba 'am sdud pa zhes pa'i skad dod mtshams sbyar bas so sor sdud par bsgyur te| de'ang bsdu bar bya ba'i yul dang*/

sdud par byed pa'i gzhi gnyis kyi bsdu bya'i yul ni/ phyi rol du gzugs la sogs pa'i yul lnga/ nang du gzugs 'dzin byed mig la sogs pa yul can lnga'am ngo bo rnams kun gzhi skye ba med pa'i yid kyi khams la bsdu'o// gnyis pa bsgom pa'i dus mtshams ni/ mdo las ko'u shi kas smras pa/ gnas brtan rab 'byor/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa des gang la rnal 'byor du byed/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ ko'u shi ka gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa de ni nam mkha' la rnal 'byor du bya'o// zhes pas mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa des bla gab med pa la rnal 'byor du byed do// zhes nyin mo'i rnal 'byor bstan to// de dag las dang po mun pa'i khang bur bsgom tshul ni/ mun khang 'khyog rim pa gsum dang ldan pa bug pa rta rnga shong sa tsam yang med pa/ 'og gzhi sa rlangs sogs med pa la| thun tshod byed pa'i glo dkar phyi yangs shing nang rub pa/ phyi la nag po'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba/ de lta bu'i gnas der sgom pa'ang*/ 'grel chen las/ gang gi tshe g.yas su sa rab tu 'bab pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pas sgom par byed pa de'i tshe cho ga 'di'o// zhes pas rlung g.yas su rgyu ba dang bstun te/ sgom rtogs kyi stan nang tshang can sogs sta gon bya zhing gnas mal sogs bkod legs par bya'o// gsum pa sgom tshul gyi yan lag ni/ sngar gyi lus gnad dang rdo rje gtsug tor gyi lta stangs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ sems kyi bzhag thabs bzhi las/ dang po spre'u sgo drung du btags pa lta bu ni/ yid dang mig gi lta stangs dang*/ rlung zhes pa sna bug kho na'i rlung 'byung 'jug la mi sems te sems rnam rtog rab tu g.yo ba 'di rlung yin pas/ 'di mdun gyi lta stangs dang bsres te bsgoms pas/

yul gzhan du rlung sems 'pho bar mi 'gyur te/ dper na khang stong du spre'u tshud na glo dkar dang rgya mthongs thams cad du spre'u re re yod pa ltar snang yang*/ de nyid sgo gcig gi drung du btags te bzhag na gcig pu de las gzhan du med pa ltar/ rlung sems nam mkhar gtad de bzhag pas rtog pa gzhan mi skye bar de nyid la rtse gcig tu bsgom mo// gnyis pa spun gsum gyi bar ma lta bu ni/ 'das pa'i rtog pa gcen po lta bur song ba thams cad kyi rjes su mi 'brang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa gcung po lta bu 'di yong dgos pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi rtog pa sngon du mi bsu/ da ltar gyi rtog pa skad cig ma 'di nyid nam mkhar gtad de gang gis kyang ma bslad par bhaiṃ/ gsum pa rnga mo'i bcings pa glod pa lta bu ni/ sgom tshul snga ma gnyis sgrim drag pas ha cang rnam rtog 'phor song ba de nyid kyi ngang du lhod kyis glod la ci yang mi sems par yid mig rlung gsum nam mkhar bzhag ste/ dper na rnga mong bskor ba'i tshe 'gro ba ltar byed kyang glod na gzhan du mi 'gro ba ltar rtog pa glod ngang nas sgom mo/ bzhi pa lha khang nang gi lder bzo lta bu ni/ lus gnad de nyid las mi g.yo zhing 'gul bskyod med pa ni lha khang nang gi lder bzo lta bu/ ngag mi g.yo ba kha ton bzlas brjod bzang ngan gyi smra ba bcad pa lha khang nang gi lder bzo lta bu/ sems mi g.yo ba re dogs phra rags bzang ngan phyogs lhung ci yang mi sems par lha khang nang gi lder bzo lta bu ste/ lus ngag yid mi g.yo zhing sems mig rlung gsum nam mkhar bzhag ste sgom mo// de'ang sha wa ris/ mi g.yo ba ni gsum ldan gyis// dhū tir rlung bcug tshud 'gyur zhing*// phyi nang rtog 'gags rtags 'byung tshe// so sor sdud pa'i yan lag go// zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ mang du smra bas ci zhig bya// chos kyi tshad ni 'di yis chog

/mig phye gyen du blta ba dang*// mthong bas bstan pa nyid kyis shes// zhes dang*/ bde mchog stod 'grel las/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te// nyi ma gcig tu nges par brtag /de'i tshe rtags bcu ma byung na// de ni nga yi rdzun tshig yin// zhes dang*/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ yid mig rlung gsum nam mkha' la// rnal 'byor mkhas pas legs sbyar na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan 'char// kun mkhyen kun gyi gsung yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ mdor hril gyis dril na/ sems mig rlung gsum rtse gcig tu nam mkhar bzhag nas/ ci yang yid la mi byed par dran pas 'jags pa yin no// 'di zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyang yin zhing lhag mthong mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'ang 'di la brten nas skye bar 'gyur ro// de ltar na mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad du yid mig rlung gsum sbrang ma gar spyin la 'byar ba lta bu'am/ spang la phur pa ba
